unrestrictedMain6Rescue4.caution: Current union 42, max overlap2; slightly sacrifices some 3+/4+ baseline cover; not selected.

metrics: draws with >=3 main number matches in any ticket

selectedTransfer.method: Mini1409-inspired Main6 + Core/Flow/Core/Tail4 with conservation of original 10-ticket incidence geometry

algorithm.baseline: Build base v3 via prev-draw ±1 neighbor count descending, tie by sum of previous200,500,800 single-digit rates descending; map top17 digits to doubled positions and remaining26 to singleton positions.
algorithm.core: On each of the last four tickets, score pairCount(previous300) +5×tripleCount(previous300); positive coefficient for Core, negative for Tail.
algorithm.flow: Exclusive A=previous identical; B=previous ±1 (excluding A); C=second-previous ±1 or same (excluding A/B); D=previous3..5 identical (excluding earlier categories); O=others. Score theoretical Band hypergeometric shape and mild preference of Flow A/B/C counts around one; no hard elimination.
algorithm.optimisation: Only swap two numerical positions between last four tickets. Deterministic xorshift32 seeded by forecast index. 160 swap proposals per draw, accept only score improvements when all tickets remain individually distinct and every pair of tickets has at most one shared number; maintain all43-digit union. Ticket position role weights: Core=0.06*CoreScore+0.25*FlowBandScore; Flow=FlowBandScore+0.016*CoreScore; Tail=-0.07*CoreScore+0.3*FlowBandScore.
limitations: This modified portfolio retains all 43 numbers and 17 double use, so number recall 6/6 is tautological.
An apparently significant outcome chosen from exploratory routes is data-mined; comparison period is not untouched.
Distance/direction-based position tweaks from the MiniLoto study are not adopted because independent test did not confirm robustness.
